name: Wirt FAQ Block
author: Rostyslav Wirt

sections.description:
Wirt FAQ Block adds a dedicated, lightweight FAQ block to the WordPress Gutenberg editor.

Create structured Frequently Asked Questions directly in the block editor without manually writing HTML or JSON-LD.

The plugin automatically generates FAQPage Schema.org structured data in JSON-LD format from your FAQ content, while keeping the visible FAQ accessible and easy to interact with.

Customize the appearance of your FAQ block using the built-in visual style editor, including spacing, colors, borders, backgrounds, and other visual properties.

Features

  • Native Gutenberg FAQ block with multiple questions and answers.
  • Automatic FAQPage Schema.org structured data in JSON-LD format.
  • Built-in visual style editor for customizing the FAQ appearance.
  • Live preview of FAQ styles on the plugin settings page.
  • Interactive accordion with expandable and collapsible questions.
  • Accessibility-friendly FAQ controls.
  • No manual HTML or JSON-LD required.

Structured Data

The plugin generates Schema.org structured data for FAQ content using the FAQPage vocabulary.

The structured data is generated from the FAQ content entered in the Gutenberg editor, helping search engines better understand the relationship between questions and answers.

Structured data does not guarantee enhanced search results or FAQ rich results. Search engines decide independently whether and how structured data is displayed.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 6.8 or later.
  • PHP 8.0 or later.
  • Gutenberg / WordPress Block Editor.

License

See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html for the full license text.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Gutenberg block editor.
  4. Add the Wirt FAQ block to your post or page.
  5. Add your questions and answers.
  6. Publish or update the content.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require a page builder?

No. Wirt FAQ Block is designed for the native WordPress Gutenberg block editor.

Can I customize the appearance of the FAQ block?

Yes. Wirt FAQ Block includes a built-in visual style editor that lets you customize spacing, colors, borders, backgrounds, and other visual properties without writing CSS.

Does the plugin generate Schema.org structured data?

Yes. The plugin automatically generates structured data based on the questions and answers configured in the FAQ block.

Is the FAQ block accessible?

The FAQ accordion uses standard buttons and ARIA attributes to provide an accessible interactive experience.

Does FAQ structured data guarantee rich results in Google?

No. Structured data helps search engines understand the content, but Google and other search engines decide whether eligible structured data is displayed as a rich result.

Can I use multiple FAQ blocks on a page?

Yes. You can add FAQ blocks to your content as needed.
